cards.text: THE VIVIENNE — B-ROLL LIBRARY V2 (ORGANIC)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: v1 was twelve variations of the same catalogue still life and has been thrown out. v2 was built by crawling TikTok for real organic handbag footage, extracting the visual register from what survived, and generating against it. Twelve moments, each in a different real room with different real light, shot like a phone snapshot. These are KEYFRAMES: nothing renders until you approve. Engine is Google Omni.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: Why v1 was wrong
cards.text: Twelve shots, one wall, one wooden surface, one warm key light, product centred every time. That is product photography with a push-in. Real b-roll is different rooms, different light, different framing, and things in the frame that nobody placed there.

cards.title: What the TikTok crawl actually returned
cards.text: 251 candidates across 6 slots and 3 term strategies. It did NOT yield drop-in b-roll and the reason is structural: about 65% of organic TikTok handbag content is caption-burned, and the uncaptioned remainder is leather-craft workshop content about wallets and small goods. The four people-with-bag slots returned zero after two rewrites. My own frame audit then killed most of what the gate passed, including one clip with burned text the gate missed and one that was just a woman smiling to camera.

cards.title: What the crawl WAS good for
cards.text: The register. Real hands with visible skin texture, phone held overhead, ordinary flat indoor light, everyday surfaces, no styling, grain and imperfect focus. Those frames are in tiktok-source/register and were wired as a second reference on every single v2 prompt, with the v1 studio set explicitly negated.

cards.title: APPROVAL GATE
cards.text: Keyframes only. Tell me which to animate and I run those through Omni. Nothing renders before that.

cards.title: Still true and still open
cards.text: No open-bag, interior or packing shots, because the lining and pocket count are unconfirmed. No real footage of our bag exists, so when samples land, refilm O2, O4, O5, O7, O9 and O10 for real. The OFFER beat is a live PDP screen recording shot the day an ad ships.
